axioms.name: Experimental.P06_15.upstream_pi_polynomial_nonvanishing
axioms.meaning: Nonvanishing of every nonzero rational polynomial at pi (independent Lindemann input); replace with the vetted ExternalPi donor, not a new target axiom.

axioms.name: Experimental.P06_15.upstream_unit_geometric
axioms.meaning: Geometric expansion of (1+u²)^(-1) on (0,1), before moment integration; does not assert beta evaluations, transcendence or Padé asymptotics.

typed_coverage: Actual beta-one integral ∫_(0,1) (1+u²)^(-1) du; for s≥2 the absolutely convergent alternating beta series; rational harmonic tails, the odd-beta density formula, eta(1) removable value and existing exact Mellin logarithmic moments. Independent pi nonvanishing and geometric expansion are explicit assumptions. No pi/4 value is included in the beta-one definition.
missing_domain_interfaces: Identification of the beta-one integral with the limit of ordered alternating partial sums and the intended Dirichlet beta value; all-k beta evaluation; algebraic-coefficient independence transfer; quantitative pi transcendence measure; Gram/rank-one construction and exterior Christoffel asymptotics.
repair_gates: For s=1, prove the ordered partial-sum limit equals the actual beta-one integral. An unordered real tsum is not the conditionally convergent alternating series and must not be used to represent beta(1). The s=0 branch is outside this item’s target domain.
Port the vetted ExternalPi/OddBetaValues donor with matching fingerprints rather than leaving the pi axiom as certification.
At k=0 use eta(1)=log 2; do not substitute into a totalized vanishing product.
The printed h^(−2k) exterior rate has an identified repair requirement; formalize the corrected asymptotic before any closure.
Qualitative pi transcendence does not supply effective C_k or exponent 7.10321.
validation: Static source review only; no Lean process, build or axiom audit run.
beta_one_definition: Actual set integral over (0,1) of 1/(1+u²); ordered alternating-series/Dirichlet identification remains open.
